title: css-decoupling: decoupling translation-invariant topological CSS codes
description: Exact decoupling of translation-invariant topological CSS codes over prime-field Laurent polynomial rings into stacks of higher-form toric codes. Implements Algorithms 1 and 2 of M. He, Y. Wang, H. Song, and Y. Gu, 'Toric codes all the way down: decoupling translation-invariant topological CSS codes in higher dimensions' (2026), and a prime-field version of the two-dimensional algorithm of arXiv:2608.09915.

creators.name: He, Mingxin
creators.affiliation: Chen-Ning Yang Institute for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University
